findings.issue: PAR (periodic automatic replenishment) is used in many hospital and textbook settings as the stocking level to refill up to, so 'The highest shelf capacity allowed' can be defended against the keyed 'stock level that triggers a reorder'.
findings.source: general pharmacy inventory usage (no federal source)
findings.fix: Reword the stem to 'the minimum stock level that triggers a reorder', or change distractor C to something clearly unrelated to stock levels (e.g. 'The number of units in one case').
